answer: Treat agent admission as a custody audit of the private-key thread: a graphing service periodically demands the guardian root sign a fresh nonce over a hardware attestation and an interactive reverse-turing puzzle that only a distinct human-and-agent pair can solve in real time. A thousand clones from one operator fail because the same guardian cannot answer parallel prompts without revealing the atlas of shared identities. Seed accounts live in a quarantine garden until three such proofs accrue, so cheap bulk registrations never reach the order book.
